purpose: A blinded, paired typed-versus-dynamic campaign derived primarily from reviewed real-redline operation families and adapted through live fixture discovery rather than old-model target replay.

tasks.prompt: The selected equipment looks undersized in its schedule. Set its supply airflow to the value in the evaluator issue note and make sure the model and schedule agree.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Discover a unique editable schedule-backed instance parameter and evaluator-held replacement value.

tasks.prompt: The note below the selected schedule is out of date. Replace it with the current issue wording and do not create a duplicate note.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed one uniquely related text note and keep replacement wording evaluator-only.

tasks.prompt: This equipment tag shows the wrong designation. Make it agree with the corresponding schedule entry.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Discover a tag, tagged element, schedule row, and editable driving parameter with a unique disagreement.
success_assertions: driving value changed rather than tag graphics

tasks.prompt: In the active coordination view, mark every visible candidate that satisfies the evaluator rule with the issue status, and leave every non-match alone.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Randomize a rule over observed instance parameters and keep expected match IDs evaluator-only.

tasks.prompt: The selected equipment is not tagged. Add one tag that matches the neighboring tags in this view and place it clearly.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Choose one taggable untagged visible element and infer tag type from observed neighbors.

tasks.prompt: The tags around the selected equipment are crowding the symbols. Clean up the layout so it reads clearly without changing what they label.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Select a bounded collision cluster and retain evaluator geometry for before/after scoring.

tasks.prompt: Add the missing device at the evaluator-marked location and match the nearby family, type, level, and orientation.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Provide a geometric marker independent of element IDs and a compatible nearby precedent.

tasks.prompt: Add the missing accessory on the selected connected branch and match the scheduled type.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed one unambiguous connected branch and approved compatible accessory type.

tasks.prompt: The selected pipe should step down after the branch instead of staying full size. Correct it and keep the network connected.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Discover a reversible pipe segment and evaluator-held target size compatible with adjacent topology.

tasks.prompt: The selected duct is supposed to reduce after the takeoff. Correct the size and keep the system connected.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Discover a reversible duct segment and target dimensions compatible with adjacent topology.

tasks.prompt: Move the selected valve clear of the evaluator clearance zone while keeping it connected and accessible.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed a movable connected accessory and evaluator-only clearance polygon.

tasks.prompt: Center the selected device between its two observed neighbors and keep its current host, level, and orientation.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Choose three compatible collinear instances and hold the center target out of the prompt.

tasks.prompt: The selected accessory is the wrong type. Change it to the scheduled compatible type and verify that its connections remain valid.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed source/target types with compatible connector schemas and evaluator-held schedule evidence.

tasks.prompt: Change the selected device to match the adjacent scheduled unit while preserving its instance data and placement.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Discover one compatible adjacent precedent and snapshot all writable instance data.

tasks.prompt: Run the missing connection from the selected branch to the selected fixture and match the nearby pipe standards.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed compatible open connectors, system, level, size, and bounded obstacle geometry.

tasks.prompt: Connect the selected air terminal to the nearby compatible supply main and match the surrounding routing.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed one unconnected terminal and compatible main with deterministic feasible route.

tasks.prompt: Reroute the selected pipe around the evaluator clearance zone while preserving its endpoints, slope, and system.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed bounded network, obstacle, and restoration snapshot.

tasks.prompt: Offset the selected duct run around the marked obstruction and keep both ends connected with the fewest practical fittings.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed a bounded duct run, obstacle volume, and feasible offset plane.

tasks.prompt: This selected accessory appears duplicated. Show exactly what Revit would remove or disconnect, but do not delete anything.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Select one existing accessory with deterministic delete preview and retain dependent-ID oracle.

tasks.prompt: The selected run appears abandoned. Trace its full bounded extent and show what would be disconnected or deleted before doing anything.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Evaluator selects a bounded connected subgraph without exposing IDs.

tasks.prompt: In the active view, make evaluator-qualified existing elements read lighter while preserving every unrelated override.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Randomize a parameter/category predicate and retain preexisting per-element/category override state.

tasks.prompt: Build the requested coordination sheet from discovered source views, follow the evaluator naming rule, and place viewports without overlap.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed eligible views, title block, naming rule, and sheet geometry.

tasks.prompt: Update the selected schedule with the requested field, filter, sorting, and grouping while leaving its underlying model values unchanged.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed one schedule with stable field definitions and evaluator-held configuration.

tasks.prompt: Using the loaded architectural link and its current transform, mark host devices that violate the evaluator room or clearance rule. Do not edit linked content.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Open the appropriate linked Snowdon discipline set and keep expected host conflicts evaluator-only.

tasks.prompt: Prepare the requested one-sheet PDF issue in staging, inspect the exact file, and publish it to the granted destination only after approval.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Seed one printable sheet and opaque staging/destination file capabilities.
success_assertions: staged PDF is valid and bound to sheet

tasks.prompt: Apply the approved evaluator-provided office rule to the active view, explain which scoped rule record you used, and leave non-matches alone.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Issue a signed, scoped, expiring context record after prompt freeze; evaluator holds the expected predicate.

tasks.prompt: Repeat the previously verified spacing cleanup on the new active view, adapting to the observed count and geometry rather than replaying old targets.
tasks.fixture_adapter: Provide a second view with perturbed count/spacing and a signed compatible prior program record.
